title: AI Techniques for Software Requirements Prioritization
shortDescription: Work as a release engineer on a Spotify-style product using 958 customer-feedback records, 360 historical release decisions, TF-IDF NLP, supervised ML, dependencies, and a 75 engineer-day release budget.
learningOutcomes: Extract requirements evidence from unstructured customer feedback using TF-IDF and cosine similarity.
Evaluate and select a supervised ML model for requirements prioritization using cross-validated metrics.
Construct a consistent feature pipeline joining NLP-derived evidence with measurable product telemetry and engineering estimates.
Apply AI predictions to a dependency-aware release plan under a finite engineering budget and critically test the robustness of the recommendation.

courseAlignment.evidence: Students investigate real NLP and supervised ML techniques applied to requirements engineering and identify limitations in automated prioritization.
Students select an NLP threshold and supervised model, implement the evidence pipeline, and apply it to a constrained release-planning problem.
Students interpret audited NLP accuracy, coverage, five-fold macro-F1, model feature importance, release probabilities, and counterfactual changes.

tasks.title: Run the Operational Baseline
tasks.description: Use support-ticket pressure and the 75-day constraint to generate a non-ML release. Inspect the live product and identify what the baseline ignores.

tasks.title: Inspect the Raw Datasets
tasks.description: Examine the current backlog, customer-feedback corpus, and historical release decisions. Identify which fields are observed, estimated, NLP-derived, or historical labels.

tasks.title: Tune the NLP Matching Threshold
tasks.description: Run ANALYZE mode, inspect audited TF-IDF/cosine matching accuracy versus coverage, and select a defensible threshold.

tasks.title: Compare Prioritization Models
tasks.description: Compare Logistic Regression and Random Forest using five-fold macro-F1 and accuracy, then choose the model you will deploy.

tasks.title: Implement the Current Feature Pipeline
tasks.description: Join NLP-derived feedback evidence with telemetry, support data, engineering estimates, dependencies, and risk fields using the same schema as historical releases.

tasks.title: Generate the AI-Assisted Release
tasks.description: Run the chosen model, inspect P(SHIPPED_NEXT), feature importance and matched customer evidence, then inspect the dependency-aware product release.

tasks.title: Run a Counterfactual or Feature Ablation
tasks.description: Change one realistic input assumption or remove one feature, retrain/re-run, and explain whether the ranking or release changes.

tasks.title: Verify and Defend the Release
tasks.description: Run engineering verification, then submit a report that distinguishes AI evidence from the final release decision.
